value.name: Karen begins sexual act
value.description: Karen starts going down on the businessman while he relaxes with his eyes closed.
evidence: Karen starts to go down on the businessman while he leans back and closes his eyes.

value.name: Dicky arrives to rob them
value.description: A beat-up station wagon pulls in behind the couple, and Dicky confronts them with a megaphone while pretending to be police.
evidence: Suddenly a beat-up station wagon pulls in behind them with its brights shining.
DICKY (through cheap megaphone SLURRING) Get outta the cah put ya hands on the roof!

value.name: Businessman surrenders to fake arrest
value.description: The businessman gets out of the car nervously, raises his hands, and obeys Dicky's commands.
evidence: The business man gets out, nervous, hands up, pants undone, puts his hands on the roof.
BUSINESSMAN (puts his hands on roof) Please, God, I never did this before, I have two kids, a wife and I support my mother and my aunt.

value.name: Dicky intimidates businessman for valuables
value.description: Dicky, hidden in silhouette, orders the businessman to empty his pockets and leave his identification, wallet, and cash on the roof.
evidence: All he sees are bright lights and Dicky's silhouette holding up a wallet like a badge.
DICKY Empty ya pockets, put everything on the roof, ID, wallet, cash.

value.name: Businessman questions Dicky's authority
value.description: Confused, the businessman asks whether Dicky is a cop as he starts to turn around.
evidence: BUSINESSMAN (confused, starts to turn) No, what? Are you - are you a cop?
DICKY (swaying, wasted drunk) Don't turn around!

value.name: Businessman empties pockets
value.description: The businessman complies and dumps the contents of his pockets onto the roof of the Volvo.
evidence: The guy empties his pockets onto the roof of the Volvo.

value.name: Dicky orders vehicle theft
value.description: Dicky tells the businessman to walk to the sidewalk because they are taking the vehicle.
evidence: DICKY Walk to the sidewalk, we have to take the vehicle.

value.name: Dicky divides stolen cash for drugs
value.description: Dicky takes the cash and tells Karen to keep half and buy rocks.
evidence: [Takes cash, mumbles to Karen] Take half, get us some rocks.

value.name: Businessman worries about getting home
value.description: After being robbed, the businessman asks how he will get home.
evidence: BUSINESSMAN How will I get home?
